description: This file implements the TpmResourceManager class and related classes for managing TPM resources, including resource allocation, deallocation, and synchronization mechanisms within the Android Open Source Project's secure environment.

classes.name: EsysLock
classes.description: A lock wrapper for ESYS_CONTEXT to ensure thread-safe access.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot
classes.description: Represents a slot for a TPM resource, manages resource cleanup.

classes.name: TpmResourceManager
classes.description: Manages TPM resource slots, including allocation and deallocation, with thread safety.

methods.name: EsysLock
methods.description: Constructor for EsysLock, initializes with ESYS_CONTEXT and mutex guard.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot::ObjectSlot
methods.description: Constructor for ObjectSlot, initializes with resource manager and resource handle.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ObjectSlot::~ObjectSlot
methods.description: Destructor for ObjectSlot, releases TPM resource if allocated.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Constructor for TpmResourceManager, initializes resource management parameters.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::~TpmResourceManager
methods.description: Destructor for TpmResourceManager, checks for outstanding resource slots.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::Esys
methods.description: Returns an EsysLock object for thread-safe access to ESYS_CONTEXT.

methods.name: TpmResourceManager::ReserveSlot
methods.description: Reserves a TPM resource slot, returns a TpmObjectSlot.
